title: CLAUDE.md
text: Controls (input, select, table, form, …) Vue instances wrapped htmlwidgets — pattern . Containers (el_container, el_row, el_col, el_card, el_collapse) plain markup carrying Element’s classes, interaction supplied Shiny input binding need . Mounting Vue instance container rebuilds DOM inside detaches component placed , anything whose job hold components must Vue instance. See lessons.md §1.2 §1.3.

title: CLAUDE.md
text: Every Vue-backed component follows structure: R function (R/el_*.R) — builds HTML tags, creates Vue instance via vueR::vue(), attaches JS handler dependency. JS handler (inst/js/el-*-handler.js) — registers Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler receive server-side update messages. Update function (update_el_*) — R file, sends session$sendCustomMessage(...) corresponding JS handler. Vue instance mounts <div id="{ns_id}_container">, vueR::vue(elementId = ns_id, ...) holds Vue data methods. Component IDs always namespaced via session$ns(id) support Shiny modules.

title: CLAUDE.md
text: el_page() — top-level page wrapper; loads Vue, Element-UI (bundled inst/element-ui, CDN), vue-handlers.js, layout CSS. Wraps shiny::fluidPage() bslib Bootstrap 5. Takes offline, locale dev. use_element() — alternative non-el_page contexts (bslib, navbarPage). Place top UI. component calls attachDependencies() .el_handler_dependency("<name>"), pairs handler JS shared el-update.js, components work even without use_element() / el_page().

Prefer components yet covered dedicated update_el_* function.

text: el_page() sets Vue root loads dependencies. Inside existing layout — fluidPage(), bslib’s page_sidebar() — call use_element() top instead:
code: library(shiny) library(shiny.element)  ui <- el_page(   el_input("name", label = "Name", placeholder = "Your name"),   el_rate("score", value = 3),   el_button("save", "Save", type = "primary"),   el_alert("hint", title = "Nothing saved yet", type = "info") )  server <- function(input, output, session) {   observeEvent(input$save, {     update_el_alert(session, "hint",       title = paste0("Saved ", input$name, " (", input$score, "/5)"),       type = "success"     )   }) }  shinyApp(ui, server) ui <- bslib::page_sidebar(   use_element(),   sidebar = bslib::sidebar(el_select("metric", choices = c("Mean", "Median"))),   el_table(data = head(iris), id = "summary") )

title: shiny.element 0.1.0
text: el_table() now takes id first, like every component: Positional calls written old el_table(data, columns, id) order still work – arguments shifted back warning – naming way keep quiet.
code: el_table("my_table", data = df)     # new el_table(data = df, id = "my_table")  # also fine, and always was

title: shiny.element 0.1.0
text: Element documents methods well props. el_call() invokes one: answer arrives input$<id>_<method> method name snake_case. component’s help page lists accepts “Element methods”.
code: observeEvent(input$clear, {   el_call(session, "tbl", "clearSelection") })  # A method with a return value answers asynchronously observeEvent(input$ask, {   el_call(session, "tree", "getCheckedKeys") }) observeEvent(input$tree_get_checked_keys, {   message("checked: ", paste(input$tree_get_checked_keys, collapse = ", ")) })
